title: Large Economies with Social Types
abstract: arXiv:2611.30620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a new general equilibrium framework for large economies with social externalities, where agents have names as well as social types. Social types define the reference groups (neighborhoods, peers, or status classes) through which externalities operate, and are primitives of the market structure. We establish that every admissible economy admits a competitive equilibrium if and only if social anonymity holds. This condition requires that observable social types do not fully identify individuals within any non-negligible subeconomy. The framework extends to generalized large economies with incomplete preferences, indivisible goods, and production, and thus accommodates nonconvexity in preferences and consumption sets. Our proof replaces the standard aggregate convexification argument with conditional convexification. Applications include peer effects, social comparison, and risk sharing with local social benchmarks.

translated_title: 具有社会类型的大型经济
translated_abstract: 本文为具有社会外部性的大型经济建立了一个新的一般均衡框架，其中经济主体既拥有名称，也拥有社会类型。社会类型定义了外部性发挥作用所依赖的参照群体（如邻里、同伴或地位阶层），并且是市场结构的原初构成要素。我们证明，每一个可容许的经济存在竞争均衡当且仅当社会匿名性成立。这一条件要求可观察的社会类型在任何不可忽略的子经济中都不能完全识别出个体。该框架可扩展至包含不完全偏好、不可分割商品和生产的一般化大型经济，因而能够容纳偏好和消费集中的非凸性。我们的证明用条件凸化替代了标准的总量凸化论证。应用领域包括同伴效应、社会比较以及基于局部社会基准的风险分担。
tldr: 本文构建了引入社会类型与社会外部性的大型经济一般均衡框架，证明竞争均衡存在当且仅当社会匿名性成立，并将该框架推广至不完全偏好、不可分割商品和生产等更一般情形。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a new general equilibrium framework for large economies with social types and externalities, proving that competitive equilibrium exists if and only if social anonymity holds, and extends the framework to incomplete preferences, indivisible goods, and production.
